segments.text: How B2B Revenue Teams Win the Shortlist on Day Zero
Preference forms early. If a buyer only finds you once they’re looking, you’re already losing.
Most B2B decisions are shaped away from vendor visibility, long before a form is filled or a call is booked

teaches B2B demand generation and revenue teams how to compete in that invisible window: earning recognition and trust at Day Zero, illuminating the dark funnel where preferences quietly form, and enabling entire buying groups to choose you on their own terms.
Grounded in current research, it is the next step beyond my previous works and can be put to action right this quarter.
As a visionary B2B marketing executive and Founder and CEO of INFUSE, I have 25+ years of experience founding and leading highly successful companies.

Focusing on solutions for B2B marketing, digital marketing, demand generation, data management, and security software, among others, I embrace innovation and transform concepts and methodologies into profitable, performance-driven businesses.
My companies made it into Inc. 5000, Inc. 500, and Entrepreneur 360 lists as some of the best, fastest-growing private companies in America.
Comprising the book’s Appendices, these worksheets equip you with the tools needed to forge your path through the dark funnel and build day zero influence:
…and more, all ready to run with your team.
